summary: Lichen International Ltd, a Fujian-domiciled foreign private issuer listed on a US exchange, filed a routine Form 6-K furnishing interim results for the six months ended June 30, 2026 and 2025, comprising MD&A (Exhibit 99.1) and unaudited interim consolidated financial statements (Exhibit 99.2). The report also recaps completed integration of the DeepSeek optimization framework into its financial and taxation AI model, completed May 2026 with a June 2026 trial, and a strategic shift toward IPO advisory and external equity investments. No transaction, price, stake, premium, advisor, or board recommendation is stated. Nothing here constitutes a special situation; watch only for disclosed operating trends and any subsequent transaction announcements.
